# Vendored TinyCC

- Upstream: https://github.com/TinyCC/tinycc
- Commit: `5cef7f3f85b0fbbd4663fd3518ba097d7fe3d738`
- Version: `0.9.28rc`
- Imported tree: `dcb896d1c7ae2e64114c55c93f5223f92280bbdf`
- License: LGPL-2.1 (see `COPYING`)
- Purpose: NaN16 target backend for the self-hosting compiler and SQLite gate.
- Local changes live in the NaN16 target files and are documented in
  `spec/TCC_NAN16.md`. Do not edit upstream files without recording the patch.

See `VENDOR` for the machine-readable provenance record.  The upstream commit
is a TinyCC repository object; it is intentionally not expected to resolve in
the nan0s history.  The imported tree hash is the stable identifier for the
snapshot that is actually vendored here.
